# Local and farmer-provided inputs

This directory is reserved for supporting inputs explicitly contemplated by the challenge brief. These are not additional NASA satellite datasets.

Examples:
- field/laboratory soil information (texture, pH, organic matter, N-P-K, salinity);
- crop characteristics (water use, forage value, nitrogen-fixing potential, rooting depth, duration, heat/frost sensitivity);
- farmer priorities and constraints (water availability, erosion reduction, organic matter improvement, market suitability and management capacity).

For every input, record its source, date, units, sampling depth/location, licence or permission, uncertainty and whether it is measured, reported, modelled or assumed.

Do not infer soil nutrients directly from SMAP soil-moisture observations, GRACE water-storage anomalies or elevation products.
